(t.folderOptions.encoding==="tcvn3"?(function(){try{var r=globalThis.__tcvn3SearchEncode(i.pattern,!!i.isRegExp);i.pattern=r.pattern;i.isRegExp=r.isRegExp;e.push("--no-unicode");if(!globalThis.__tcvn3Dec)globalThis.__tcvn3Dec=(function(){try{var _iv=require("@vscode/iconv-lite-umd");return function(b){return _iv.decode(b,"tcvn3");};}catch(_e){return null;}})();}catch(_e){}})():t.folderOptions.encoding&&t.folderOptions.encoding!=="utf8"&&e.push("--encoding",t.folderOptions.encoding))
